guard/30433.htm.text: Sentry Kathaway: Hello, I am Sentry Kathaway and I watch the Neutral Zone. The Neutral Zone begins right after you cross this bridge. If you continue on the road south through the Neutral Zone, you will come to Gludio Castle and Gludio Castle Town.

guard/30433-1.htm.text: Sentry Kathaway: The town of Gludio is the closest Human habitation to here. If you go there, there is a Dark Elven Guild that teaches Dark Elves and changes their profession. I myself often call on the Dark Elven Guild there by using this road.
